title: Nicknames
description: Nickname plugin with skin switching, menu and command support. The nickname works everywhere, not just in chat and tab.
body:
# NickPlugin

A true nickname system – with skins, a clean GUI, and full command support.

Most nickname plugins only change a player's name in chat and the tab list. NickPlugin goes further: the nickname appears everywhere – in the tab list, chat, above the player's head, command outputs, death messages, advancement messages, and more. Players can even automatically use the skin of the chosen nickname. Everything is managed through a clean and intuitive inventory-based GUI.

## ✨ Features

* 🧑‍🎤 **True Nicknames** – Changes the displayed profile name so nicknames appear in commands, death messages, advancements, and more.
* 🎭 **Skin Integration** – Automatically fetches skins from real Minecraft accounts through Mojang.
* 🖥️ **Clean GUI** – Full nickname management through `/nick`.
* ⚙️ **Command Resolution** – Commands like `/give <Nick>`, `/tp <Nick>`, and others work automatically.
* 🛡️ **Advanced Permissions** – Separate permissions for every action, OP-only by default.
* 👀 **OP Notifications** – Shows the real player name behind a nickname when they join.
* 🎲 **Random Nicknames** – Instantly assign a random nickname.
* 💛 **Clean Join/Quit Messages** – Consistent nickname handling across join and leave events.
* 💾 **Persistent Storage** – Nicknames and settings remain after server restarts.

## 🎮 Commands

| Command                 | Description                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `/nick`                 | Opens the nickname GUI                                       |
| `/nick <name>`          | Sets a nickname directly                                     |
| `/nick off`             | Removes the nickname and restores the original name and skin |
| `/nick <player> <name>` | Sets another player's nickname (Admin)                       |
| `/realname <nick>`      | Shows the real player behind a nickname                      |

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission      | Default | Description                          |
| --------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `nick.use`      | OP      | Use the nickname system and GUI      |
| `nick.skin`     | OP      | Apply the target player's skin       |
| `nick.random`   | OP      | Use random nicknames                 |
| `nick.steal`    | OP      | Copy any player's skin               |
| `nick.realname` | OP      | View the real name behind a nickname |
| `nick.others`   | OP      | Change other players' nicknames      |
| `nick.notify`   | OP      | See real names on player join        |
| `nick.*`        | OP      | Grants all permissions               |

All permissions are OP-only by default but can be assigned to ranks using permission managers such as LuckPerms.

## 📦 Installation

1. Place `NickPlugin.jar` into your server's `plugins` folder.
2. Restart your server.
3. Done – no configuration required.

## ✅ Compatibility

* Spigot / Paper 1.21.x
* Java 21+
* Skin fetching requires `online-mode=true`
